name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-06-09, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
